note: v1 lost most of its score by standing still. In seed 303 and for about 15 s of seed 101, the coin sat on the top platform at (250,30). The only way up is a jump that slides along the ceiling, which v1's simulator could not reproduce, so every action showed the same 'no route' eta and idle won the tie. The previous attempt added that slide (a small step-up) but also scored the route distance on every grounded 1/60 s frame. Every action then looked within 0.02 s of standing still, so idle won 534-562 of 600 decisions. This version goes back to v1's rule: route distance counts only at 0.1 s tick boundaries or after a real landing, so waiting always costs 0.1 s. It keeps the useful parts of the last attempt: the step-up, the 1/60 s simulation with 2 frames of input lag, the fixed player hitbox and the fallback that pulls toward the coin when no route is known. It drops the roomy and kills rules, adds jump-then-release follow-ups, builds the route map within a few frames, and adds coinOverdue, which takes idle out of the candidates when a coin has stayed uncollected well past its prediction.
instructions:
Super Coin Box: run (Left/Right) and jump (Up) to grab the coin; a new one appears elsewhere each time. Enemies fall in from the top: landing on one from above kills it, any other touch costs a life (3 lives). Collect as many coins as possible.
Forecast fields: ifIdle, ifLeft, ifRight, ifJump, ifJumpLeft, ifJumpRight each simulate choosing that action now (it takes effect after about 0.03 s of input lag and is held for 0.1 s), followed by the best of a set of simple follow-up moves, against the level map and every enemy's predicted path for 1.4 s. safe = true: some follow-up avoids every enemy, the bottom pit and the top of the world. eta = predicted seconds until the coin is touched (below 50: a known route; 50 to 75: no route known, smaller = closer to the coin; 99: no coin or nothing safe). Waiting always makes eta at least 0.1 larger. hitIn = seconds until contact for an action that is not safe (9 when safe). coinOverdue = true when the current coin has stayed uncollected more than 2.5 s longer than first predicted (the player is stalling).
Rules: 1) If playing is false (between lives, level change, game over), choose jump or click, 50/50. 2) Candidates: the actions whose safe is true; if coinOverdue is true, leave idle out of the candidates. 3) If there are candidates, go through them in the order idle, right, left, jumpRight, jumpLeft, jump: keep the first one, and switch to a later one only when its eta is more than 0.04 smaller than the eta of the one kept. 4) If there are no candidates but ifIdle.safe is true (only possible when coinOverdue is true), choose idle. 5) If no action is safe, choose the largest hitIn (on a tie the smaller eta, then the earlier in that same order). 6) If the ifX fields are missing, go right when coinDx > 10, left when coinDx < -10, otherwise idle.
Context only: coinEta = best eta among the safe actions, routeKnown = coinEta below 50, enemies = the 3 nearest threats (dx, dy from the player, positive dy = below; vx, vy), onGround, pitBelow, lives, graphReady = the route map is complete.

actions.description: release all keys: stand still, or drop straight down when airborne
jump straight up (Up held; jumps again on landing)
jump while running left (Up held; jumps again on landing)
jump while running right (Up held; jumps again on landing)
click the game centre (start or restart screens)

tests.why: The extractor must run without throwing on real frames, including coin pickups (the player hitbox briefly grows), a level-2 map, a life lost and the end screen.
Whenever the player is in play, the per-action forecasts, coinEta and coinOverdue must be present, because the teacher's rules read them.

tests.expect: !(state.playing && state.onGround && state.graphReady && state.ifIdle && state.ifIdle.safe && state.coinEta > 0.3 && state.coinEta < 50 && (state.enemies || []).every(function (e) { return Math.abs(e.dx) + Math.abs(e.dy) > 220; })) || state.ifIdle.eta > Math.min(state.ifLeft.eta, state.ifRight.eta, state.ifJump.eta, state.ifJumpLeft.eta, state.ifJumpRight.eta) + 0.04
tests.why: Pins the stall fix. On the ground, with a known route and no enemy nearby, waiting must cost more than the 0.04 tie margin. The previous attempt scored route distance on every grounded frame, so idle was within 0.02 of moving and the player stood still for whole games.
